source_row.extraction_instructions: Nuxt SPA; ?page=N is ignored server-side. list_shells_override loads the calendar in the browser, captures the site's own public GraphQL Authorization header, then pages entries (16/page, offset) from cms.uroweb.org/graphql until entryCount; live upcoming events only (on-demand excluded). Detail pages are server-rendered: .lead description, .event-details table (Organiser, CME, Venue, Location 'City, Country'). No fees are published (registration is on organiser sites), so pricing is []. Specialty is always Urology.

concerns: Recon volume estimate of ~700 was the sitemap (includes past + on-demand). The calendar's own entryCount is 55 upcoming live events; all 55 fetched, unique, matching. Two runs identical.
On-demand education (/education-events/education, separate Craft entry type) is deliberately excluded; revisit if wanted via is_on_demand.
No fees on any EAU page (registration is on external organiser sites), so pricing_tiers is [] for all events; booking_url is the uroweb event page, not the organiser's external 'Join event' link.

Listing depends on capturing the site's public GraphQL bearer token from a browser request and on the Craft query shape; a site redesign could break it. After 3 failed tries it logs an error and returns [] (no silent partial listing).
Multi-day courses like Robotic Urology Course show a single date in the site's dateRange even when the text says two days; extractor follows the site's date.
Some pages have no description (e.g. Eger ESU course); description is then None. Site-wide boilerplate meta description is deliberately rejected.
Region holds the country from 'City, Country'; shell city is used when the page has no Location row (region None then).
